name: 11216 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11216 (Brooklyn) has 283 nonprofit organizations. 110 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11216 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
